submitted.rationale: AgSbO3 (Sb fraction 0.5) is the only ternary phase that appears in the database, so I measured the compositions around it. EQE: idx6 (0.41) 0.043%, idx8 (0.468) 0.183%, idx9 (0.52) 0.095%, idx10 (0.561) 0.080%, idx12 (0.636) 0.060%. The peak is at idx8, just on the Ag-rich side of AgSbO3 stoichiometry.
